name: Koyori ~SEVENDAYS~
source: A young office worker named Shin'ichi meets up with a girl from a dating site, only to find out that she is way younger than he expected. To his dismay, the mysterious girl insists that she is interested in him, and invites herself over to stay at his place. Will Shin'ichi send her on her way, or will he fall victim to temptation?...
translation: 一位名叫新一的年轻上班族在约会网站上认识了一位女孩，却发现她比他想象的要年轻得多。令他沮丧的是，神秘女孩坚持说她对他感兴趣，并邀请自己住在他的住处。新一会送她上路，还是会成为诱惑的受害者？……
